limitations: Every EPE distribution/quantile/bin is over 5106 PAIR-MEAN EPE values, not individual-point EPE.
Point-level P99, point error bins, boundary distances and boundary error cannot be reconstructed from these reports.
predicted_valid_coverage is the fraction of all D16 predictions within target cell-center bounds; it is not GT boundary accuracy.
Loss-component contributions below are scalar arithmetic decomposition, not gradient magnitudes or proof of gradient competition.
Pair correlations and post-training-defined tail groups are descriptive, not causal or independent confirmation.
A descending final epoch does not establish nonconvergence; additional training requires a same-loss equal-budget control.

frozen_summary.label: frozen_v1_flow_baseline
frozen_summary.selection_protocol: Pure frozen baseline; Flow EPE, macro per pair, fixed full RGB512 val

derived_point_weighted_mean.note: Only pooled mean is derived from pair mean*GT count; no point-level quantile/distribution is inferred.

epoch_interpretation.note: Final epoch improved 9.37%; tail contribution remained near 0.183px. This supports an equal-budget continuation diagnostic, not a claim that more training must help.

scalar_loss_decomposition.note: Scalar loss values only. These fractions do not measure gradient shares or demonstrate gradient conflict.

existing_geometry_loss_units.note: Shrinking robust scale can reduce influence of large outliers; point-level diagnostic evidence is needed before choosing a replacement.

budget_control_recommendation.control: Clone the same completed checkpoint, optimizer state, LR protocol, RNG and sample order into same-loss and proposed-loss continuation arms; equal additional updates and validation selection.
budget_control_recommendation.attribution: A proposed loss trained for extra steps cannot be compared only with the unchanged 5-epoch model to claim a loss benefit.

full_pair_artifact.policy: Keep the complete per-pair output outside Git; this versioned file contains summaries and fixed worst-case sets.
